plan.notes: Source: Otterbein University Department of Biology and Earth Science official 'Suggested Program of Study' for the Biology Major (BS). SUGGESTED SEQUENCE — the document is explicitly a suggested program of study, not a required lockstep sequence. No explicit catalog year on the document; the PDF footer carries revision stamp 2/18/26, so catalog year is recorded as 2025-2026. Credit ranges resolved at minimums with disclosure: 'BIO Major Elective 3-4' slots transcribed at 3 credits; the 'BIO Major Elective or BIO 4950 Research (optional)' fall-senior slot is one or-slot transcribed at 3. Term totals as transcribed (minimums): 15+15+15+14+13.5+13.5+15+15 = 116. The source prints junior-year term totals of 14-15 (row-by-row minimums sum to 13.5) and requires 120 hours to graduate (footnote g); the gap is filled by student choice within the plan's ranges and electives. Courses marked '(skills)' in the source satisfy Otterbein's skill-development block. MATH 1800 Calculus II, BIO 4998 Scientific Writing, and BIO 4950 Research are marked optional in the source and are shown where the source grids them. 'INST 2XXX' = any INST 2000-level course (the source notes the four INST 2000-level courses may be taken in any order). PHYS 1100/1500 and PHYS 1200/1600 are alternative lecture+lab pairs (1500/1600 requires calculus). No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence left empty. BIO 3998 is taken in both semesters of junior year by program design (two semesters required per source footnote c); allow_repeated_courses is set.
